statement.p: A thyroid peroxidase antibody test was performed on a 45 year old man. The dilution sequence was 40 \displaystyle\mu{L} serum added to 320 \displaystyle\mu{L} of diluent in tube 1. Then 60 \displaystyle\mu{L} from tube 1 was added to 120 \displaystyle\mu{L} of diluent in tube 2. Finally 25 \displaystyle\mu{L} from tube 2 was added to 175 \displaystyle\mu{L} of diluent in tube 3.
All dilution factors should be given as fractions.
a.) What is the dilution ratio in tube 1? Your answer should be in the form of \displaystyle\frac{{1}}{\text{number}}.
b.) What is the ratio of the liquid from tube 1 in tube 2 after they are mixed?
c.) What is the ratio of the liquid from tube 2 in tube 3 after they are mixed?
d.) What is the ratio of the original serum in tube 3? That is, what is the overall (serial) dilution ratio?
